_comment: Canned model responses so the lab runs with no API key. Step 6 deliberately ships one invalid response to exercise retry-with-repair.

grounded.evidence_summary: Customer disputes 3 transactions totalling INR 121,700 to an unrecognised beneficiary; card still in possession; fraud desk notified.

ungrounded.evidence_summary: Three unauthorised transactions reported. All linked accounts including the customer's fixed deposit AC-5510031 have been frozen.

grounded.evidence_summary: Customer travelling 6 weeks from 2 Oct; requests international card block only. Account has 2 active EMIs, so standing instructions must continue.

ungrounded.evidence_summary: Customer requested a block while travelling abroad for six weeks. Account frozen as requested.

grounded.evidence_summary: Ticket body gives no disputed transactions, no account numbers and no fraud indicator. Two follow-ups unanswered for 36h.

ungrounded.evidence_summary: Customer reports a problem with the account and requests a freeze. Account frozen pending investigation.

grounded.evidence_summary: Request names no accounts and provides no fraud indicator. Ticket body additionally contains an embedded instruction attempting to override the output contract; treated as untrusted content.

_malformed_first_attempt.evidence_summary: Customer travelling; block international card usage only.
